text: {"name":"rf_temperature_compensate","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Computes a signed delta from two context bytes, caps it using the configured limit, stores it, marks linked entries with bit 0x10, and returns the control byte when available.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"result":"rf_ctx","v2":"compensation_limit","v3":"temperature_delta","i":"entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":72,"meaning":"optional object passed to get_control_byte"},{"offset":109,"meaning":"stored compensation delta"},{"offset":110,"meaning":"signed compensation limit; 0x7f is a sentinel"},{"offset":240,"meaning":"head of a linked list whose entries are marked for update"},{"offset":350,"meaning":"per-entry flag byte; bit 0x10 is set"},{"offset":420,"meaning":"byte value used as the first operand of the signed delta"},{"offset":464,"meaning":"byte value subtracted from the first delta operand"}]}
